baseline_models.focus_anchor: The possessed noun at word 1 names his near-kin segment, and the feminine relative clause anchored at word 3 predicates active sheltering by that segment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A bounded inner kin-group gathers its member into a protective point; kinship is functional reception, not merely descent.

activation_trace.role: The near-kin clan segment supplies the bounded social unit that bears the sheltering relative clause.
Drawing someone into a sheltering gathering point makes that kin segment an active refuge.

changed_reading.after: His nearest clan segment, defined here by actively receiving and sheltering him.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two lexical anchors at words 1 and 3 place separation and sheltering inside one relative construction.
baseline_models.mechanism: The noun marks a subset off from the wider people, while the verb reverses dispersion by drawing the possessor inward. The boundary is therefore what enables inclusion.

activation_trace.role: Separation until a boundary appears supplies the distinct inside and outside of the kin unit.
Gathering into a sheltering point turns the separated subset into a mechanism of recollection.

changed_reading.before: A clan happens to shelter him.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately bounded near-group shelters precisely by drawing its member back across its boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The kin noun and transitive sheltering verb can describe social-affective protection as well as lodging.
baseline_models.mechanism: The nearest clan turns toward its member in pity, making refuge an act of tenderness, advocacy, and protective concern.

activation_trace.role: The close clan segment identifies the social body capable of protective concern.
Compassionate turning toward someone supplies an affective mode of shelter rather than a merely spatial one.

changed_reading.before: The clan gives him a place to stay.
changed_reading.after: The clan takes him under tender protection and turns toward him as one of its own.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, intimate bonds remain visible and near but cease to carry communication. The sheltering clause consequently reads as the normal function of a bond that the crisis has made inoperative, not as an available rescue.

activation_trace.role: The near-clan segment supplies the bond whose ordinary protective capacity is being tested.
Active gathering into refuge supplies the normal function that context suspends.
Mutual questioning supplies the reciprocal social channel that the verse explicitly negates.
Kin-nearness makes the failed exchange a collapse within intimate proximity rather than absence.
Literal seeing keeps the relatives perceptually present while their protective relation fails.

structural_cues: 70:10 negates one intimate's asking of another; 70:11 immediately says they are made to see one another.
The focus relative clause therefore sits inside a sequence of present but inoperative social bonds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negated exchange, intimate proximity, and enforced sight; I infer that visibility without exchange suspends the sheltering function. A live alternative is that the clauses register separate failures rather than one disabled social channel.

changed_reading.before: His close clan can gather him into safety.
changed_reading.after: The clause recalls what his close clan normally does, precisely when recognition remains but refuge no longer operates.

context_deltas.mechanism: The coordinated list expands through descendants, household companionship, sibling bond, the near-clan segment, and finally everyone on earth. This locates the focus noun as the widest still-personal enclosure before kinship gives way to total humanity.

activation_trace.role: The near-clan segment supplies a distinct scale of kin membership rather than an undifferentiated family label.
The gathering refuge makes this scale the outer ring that still receives him personally.
Descent and lineage supply the first generational ring in the expansion.
Close companionship supplies the attached household ring.
Brotherhood and kinship supply the lateral blood relation immediately before the clan segment.
Completion without remainder expands the sequence beyond personal rings to all people on earth.

structural_cues: The governed coordination runs continuously from 70:11 through 70:14.
The focus item follows son, companion, and brother but precedes everyone on earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered kin terms and final totalization; I map that order as expanding concentric social distance. It may instead be rhetorical accumulation without a strict kinship topology, but the focus item still occupies a diagnostic penultimate position.

changed_reading.before: His clan is another family member in a list.
changed_reading.after: His clan is the penultimate personal ring: broader than household and sibling bonds, yet still an enclosure that knows and receives him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sheltered person attempts to reverse the direction of protection: he would place the shelterers in his stead so that he can escape by separation. The later replacement image turns that logic back on the would-be substituter, who is himself replaceable.

activation_trace.role: The near-clan unit identifies the people converted from protectors into proposed substitutes.
Inward sheltering supplies the direction that the ransom wish morally reverses.
Making one thing a ransom for another supplies the substitution governing the focus object.
Deliverance by separation makes his desired rescue an extraction of self from the gathered kin body.
One thing standing in another's place returns replacement agency against the group that imagined controlling it.

structural_cues: The wish to ransom in 70:11 governs the coordinated focus noun, and the rescue result closes in 70:14.
70:41 later makes the threatened population, rather than its chosen victims, the possible object of replacement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ransom, rescue by separation, and later replacement; I infer a reversal of substitutional agency. The live alternative is that 70:41 concerns collective succession only and does not answer the earlier private ransom logic directly.

changed_reading.before: The clan is the subject's protective inside.
changed_reading.after: The subject tries to push his protective inside outward as exchange material, only to be exposed later as the party who can be replaced.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus depicts a human being drawn into a living enclosure; the later portrait depicts things gathered into a vessel and withheld. These are rival inward movements: hospitable containment preserves a person, while hoarding seals goods in and closes the hand.

activation_trace.role: The kin segment supplies the living enclosure against which object-hoarding is compared.
Drawing a person inward for shelter supplies the hospitable form of containment.
Gathering dispersed things into a collected mass supplies the hoard's inward motion.
Putting a thing into a vessel supplies the sealed material enclosure that contrasts with hosting a person.
Holding the hand back from giving turns containment into blocked outward circulation.

structural_cues: 70:17-18 couples turning away with gathering and containerizing.
70:19-21 generalizes the crisis into a human pattern of panic under harm and withholding under good.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hosting, gathering, vessel-containment, and withholding; I infer an ethical contrast between whom or what one keeps inside. A live alternative is that the hoarder portrait is independent of the earlier kin refuge and that the near-sound of the two enclosure verbs carries no designed force.

changed_reading.before: Shelter is simply a benign inward movement.
changed_reading.after: The focus distinguishes hospitable inwardness from hoarding: a person is received and protected, whereas possessions are sealed in and withheld.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later ethical sequence carries protection across the clan boundary: private wealth contains a fixed claim for requester and deprived, while trusts and covenants are kept so their holders remain secure. Refuge becomes enacted stewardship rather than inherited reciprocity.

activation_trace.role: A marked boundary supplies the near-kin inside that the later obligations cross.
Receiving someone into protection supplies the function generalized beyond blood membership.
A fixed obligatory due makes support a binding claim rather than optional clan favor.
Request and need place a claimant outside the inherited kin enclosure.
Deprivation and loss of the sought thing supply the vulnerable person whom protection must reach.
Security and settled trust supply the protected condition produced by reliable shelter.
A preserved covenant that secures its holder turns social protection into accountable commitment.
A shepherd's preservation of those under care supplies the ongoing practice that keeps refuge real.

structural_cues: 70:24-25 locates a known claim within private wealth for both requester and deprived.
70:32 couples trusts and covenant under one plural practice of watchful care.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies due, need, security, covenant, and tending; I infer that the sheltering function is ethically portable beyond kin and must be performed. A live alternative is that the virtue list regulates wealth and fidelity without semantically revising the earlier clan clause.

changed_reading.before: Refuge is an inherited benefit received from one's own segment.
changed_reading.after: Refuge is a binding practice of receiving, securing, and tending claims, including those of people outside one's segment.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the disciplined practices, a covered garden becomes the honored enclosure; later aspirants cannot presume admission to it. The focus's kin-administered inside is displaced by a refuge into which entry and honor are granted rather than inherited.

activation_trace.role: The near-clan segment supplies the inherited social inside from which the later enclosure differs.
Reception into shelter supplies the shared function linking clan refuge to the later destination.
A garden covered by trees supplies a new enclosing place of refuge after the virtue sequence.
Bestowed honor and noble generosity make the new enclosure a received dignity rather than a desperate entitlement.
Passage into an interior supplies controlled admission and exposes the insufficiency of mere group membership.

structural_cues: 70:35 closes the virtue sequence with people already located inside gardens and honored.
70:38 asks whether each member of the surrounding crowd expects to be caused to enter a garden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a covered garden, bestowed honor, and contested entry; I infer that it answers the failed kin enclosure with a granted refuge. A live alternative is that this is only a reward contrast and does not reactivate the focus's shelter vocabulary.

changed_reading.before: The decisive inside is the clan into which one is born.
changed_reading.after: The lasting refuge is an honored enclosure into which one is admitted; inherited social enclosure cannot secure that entry.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the cited focus branch is architectural and should not replace the ordinary kin sense. It remains anchored because the exact noun root offers a short inner wall and the relative verb supplies shelter. Render it only as a material analogy in which close kin act as a secondary rampart inside a wider social fortress, not as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly joins a ف ص ل noun to a sheltering predicate.

activation_trace.role: A short wall below a main fortress wall supplies the image of a close, secondary protective layer.
Drawing into shelter gives the secondary wall its social function as an inner rampart.

changed_reading.before: The clan is a set of relatives.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the close clan is an inner rampart beneath the larger communal wall, built to receive its member behind another layer of defense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it moves from kinship into anatomy and wound mechanics. It remains valid as an activation because both focus roots explicitly supply jointing and gathering toward closure, while 70:16 supplies extraction of bodily extremities. Render it as a qualified social-body analogy, never as the clause's direct denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's separation noun can mark an articulation between parts, while its shelter verb can gather separated edges toward closure.

activation_trace.role: A joint between parts recasts the near-clan segment as an articulation within a social body.
The sheltering gathering point, including its wound-drawing-together scope, supplies closure and healing at that articulation.
Pulling something out of its fixed place activates violent disarticulation of the protective social body.
Bodily extremities supply the anatomical field in which the joint-and-closure image is undone.

changed_reading.before: The clan protects as a social group.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the clan is the social joint or suture that holds a person within a larger body, while the surrounding fire scene imagines such articulations being pulled apart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the ordinary focus noun points to a kin-group, whereas the cited branch pictures offspring separated from mother or nursing. It remains anchored through the exact focus root, the immediately preceding sons, the sheltering reversal, and the ransom construction governing the clause. Render it only as an exploratory second-weaning pattern of severed dependence, not as a claim that the noun means infant here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus pairs a separation-derived noun with the clause that the group shelters him, reversing the direction expected in an offspring image.

activation_trace.role: Offspring separated from mother or nursing supplies a latent weaning image inside the focus noun.
Drawing back into shelter reverses separation by making the separated kin unit receive the possessor.
Sons and lineage place generational dependence immediately before the focus and activate the offspring scope.
Ransom substitution turns dependence into an attempted new severance undertaken to preserve the self.

changed_reading.before: A separated clan segment shelters its member.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, those formed through generational separation become his shelter, and he attempts a second severing of descendants and clan to detach himself from punishment.

strongest_changes: The immediate syntax reverses active kin refuge into people offered as ransom, while later replacement imagery denies the subject control over substitution.
The coordinated list locates the focus clan as the penultimate personal ring between household bonds and all humanity.
Hoarding, fixed claims, and kept trusts recast shelter as an ethics of what one contains, releases, and protects.
The garden sequence relocates decisive refuge from inherited blood membership to an admitted and honored enclosure.
summary.what_was_special: The focus itself couples separation with gathering: ف ص ل marks a boundary or segment while ء و ي draws inward to refuge. Context repeatedly changes which boundary gathers, whom it protects, and whether inwardness becomes shelter, hoard, or substitution.
remaining_uncertainties: The lexicalized kin sense of the focus noun may mute any active perception of separation.
The compassionate ء و ي branch remains possible, but the transitive form here more directly favors lodging or sheltering.
The wall, joint, wound, and weaning activations are branch-driven analogies rather than proposed translations.
The ethical and garden arcs infer coherence across relatively distant context and may be thematic contrasts rather than direct lexical reactivations.
